messages:
maria-cs: FYI BrightShip reported their ingest broke after our release yesterday afternoon — parser is getting a string where it expects an array. Happened for /v1/generate-order responses. attaching sample below.

ashley-support: Ouch. Do we have a raw response example? customer says it started ~15:40 PDT and affects ~20% of calls for them.

maria-cs: here's the exact chunk from the response they forwarded:

```
expected: {
  "items": [ {"sku": "ABC123", "qty": 2}, {"sku": "XYZ9", "qty": 1} ]
}
actual: {
  "items": "[{\"sku\": \"ABC123\", \"qty\": 2}, {\"sku\": \"XYZ9\", \"qty\": 1}]"
}
```

liam-eng: thanks — that looks like the array got JSON.stringified somewhere in the response path. Were there any template/formatter changes in yesterday's release?

oliver-ml: Model variant/logging wise we didn't change any output shaping. This looks downstream (response wrapper).

ashley-support: repro steps from customer: 1) POST /v1/generate-order with sample prompt 2) parse JSON in their ingest pipeline (strict parser) 3) failure. They ran curl and attached the raw body.

ashley-support: curl they used:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate-order \n  -H 'Authorization: Bearer <key>' \n  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \n  -d '{"order_prompt":"items for warm-weather kit"}'
```

maria-cs: their parser error: `json.decoder.JSONDecodeError: Expecting value: line 1 column 12 (char 11)` when trying to load the items field as JSON because it's a string.

liam-eng: @deploy-bot can you show the deploy diff for the release that went out ~15:30 PDT? Looking for response serializer or api-formatter changes.

deploy-bot: deploy #deploy-2026-03-16-88 finished by ops-release. Changed files: api/formatters/order_formatter.py, runbook/notes.md. No rollback triggered.

liam-eng: OK that points to order_formatter. paging @oliver-ml in case any model-side postprocessing was added as a shim.

oliver-ml: I didn't touch formatters. I did add a small post-filter for rare tokens but it's in model-serving layer and shouldn't stringify arrays.

sre-oncall: Are we degrading customers? BrightShip says 20% of their calls fail. Can we hotfix?

liam-eng: quick mitigation: add a defensive parser/unchain step to order_formatter to ensure items stays an array if it's a JSON string. I'll open PR for a short-circuit fix, then we can roll a patch.

ashley-support: please confirm with BrightShip before/after steps so they can validate. I can coordinate a test window.

maria-cs: customer has allowed a test run — they provided an api key we can use to reproduce in prod. I've DM'ed the key to @liam-eng.

liam-eng: got it. Reproduced with their key in staging. Quick patch in branch `fix/unwrap-items-string`. Test shows items is now an array when the server returns a stringified array.

liam-eng: PR opened: https://git.redwood/company/api/pull/4127 — change is tiny (detect string field and json.loads) and includes unit tests.

oliver-ml: After we patch, we should add a regression test to our evals for structured output to catch string-wrapping regressions. I'll add a test case.

deploy-bot: promoted PR 4127 to canary via pipeline canary-3 at 2026-03-17T02:10Z. No errors in smoke tests.

liam-eng: rolling to prod now. Noting: don't want to mask genuine model behaviour where model should output array vs string — this is defensive for accidental serializer bugs.

maria-cs: BrightShip confirming they're seeing success on a few calls now. Will continue to monitor.

ashley-support: I'll keep the ticket open and ask them to monitor for 24h. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
